statement: Scenario A latency and efficiency research has a valid substrate and honest records. A research profile class, dispatch family and subkind exist that admission refuses by one explicit reason and the record writer refuses to place in the published store. The runner accepts --profile research (one fresh deployment per run on the existing lifecycle; the dry run prints the frozen plan and that nothing is admissible; --storage-root and a passed semantic gate are required). Three Lagrange nodes run on one lab host on a campaign-scoped Docker bridge network (created and removed by the campaign's own deployment and cleanup owners, labelled with the campaign; a leftover network is a closure failure), declared truthfully: one host, the machine's real host name on every node, declared host count 1, standard ports on each node's own bridge address, the load generator on the same host, refused for every non-research plan. Every run records a substrate descriptor and a round-trip matrix (the load-generator-to-endpoint path and every ordered node pair, on the bridge for one host) measured before and after the window, never during it. The dataset reset method is reported by the adapter that performed it. Every statement carries a monotonic start and end in a per-attempt timeline indexed into a per-run statement catalog. Retained statement evidence of every profile is brought into the campaign evidence beside the raw record, digest-verified, before the load-generator worktree is released, and a missing or mismatching file is a typed evidence failure. An unverified seed is never warmed up or measured. Physical evidence: one research run on one lab host.

constraints.statement: Unsealed draft. The measured red value is 10 unmet properties (stage 1, one WIP commit). The lead seals and lands; no implementer runs start or land. The guard imports harness modules in process, reads the two declared retained artifacts and starts no cluster (R27); the physical run on one lab host is the lead's and is retained as an artifact, never produced by the guard.

Proof apparatus never changes src/. A product refusal of replication factor three on one declared host would be reported, not worked around. Writable paths are the harness, reference-client adapter, runner CLI, runbook, home-lab single-host paragraph, the guard, the recompute check and the reset-method constant of the paired-sweep runner guard named in the brief; data/tidb-comparison/ is never touched.

One version of any logic (R11). resetMethodOf(system) is deleted, not kept beside the adapter-reported method. The single-host substrate is a named substrate value consumed by the planner, host facts and descriptor; any non-research plan refuses it. The five single-host blockers are lifted for the research class only, never by a silent relaxation. Statement-evidence custody has one bound and one mechanism for every profile; only the timeline is always inline. No flag, mode, compatibility alias or default standing in for something not measured.

No synthetic host identity (ruling 14): one host, three nodes, the machine's real host name on every node, declared host count 1. Ruling A: the single-host substrate is a campaign-scoped Docker bridge network, nodes addressed as the development harness addresses them in bridge mode (read through the campaign deployer's own owners, never by importing the development lifecycle class), standard ports, no port blocks. The inter-node path is docker-bridge; a record claiming lan or loopback for one host is rejected. Multi-host substrates keep host networking unchanged.

The smoke and capacity profiles stay byte-identical where plan digests of published records are recomputed by admission: stage 2 adds the golden digests of the smoke profile as a witness. Published records are append-only history; the 22 fresh-formation and 15 truncate-and-reload values in data/tidb-comparison/raw-observations.ndjson stay as written.

Stage 1: guard and in-process red witnesses only. Stage 2: profile class and barriers, reset method, timeline, custody and seed gate with their witnesses green and the existing campaign tests green. Stage 3: single-host substrate, descriptor and round trip. The guard's negative controls (a missing timeline entry, a reset method contradicting its per-table outcomes, a single-host record claiming lan, a round trip inside the window, a research record placed in a scratch copy of the published store) must be seen rejected by the verifier.

Before changing a pinned value, search solve/quests, architecture/contracts, test/guidelines and scripts/checks. Stage 1 found no sealed quest, invariant or guideline that pins the reset-method strings; the consumers are the fixtures and assertions listed in evidence/stage1-findings.md.

Ruling B: a three-host run depends on the household network (same build 98/100 at night, product failure next morning; reports/lab-base-ab3-three-01.md), and this quest's claim is the substrate and honest records. The multi-host descriptor and round-trip matrix stay witnessed in process (property 9); the first multi-host research session is recorded as evidence when it happens and is not part of the seal.
